connector.name: Hojincheck
connector.registryDescription: Verify Japanese companies, invoice-issuer registrations and addresses against government open data.
connector.summary: Hosted at hojincheck.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.hojincheck, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key as a Bearer token, e.g. 'Bearer hjc_live_...'. Get a free key at https://hojincheck.com/signup (100 requests/day). X-Api-Key is also accepted.
